sources.snippet: Overview wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-english is a fine-tuned English automatic speech recognition model built on Facebook's XLSR-53 architecture, developed by jonatasgrosman. The model fine-tunes the multilingual facebook/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53 base on English using Common Voice 6.1 train and validation splits.
